text:
The change adds optional custom shipping rates and CSV loading. One problem: `RatesFile` keeps the file open after loading all its contents. An in-memory check confirmed the handle remains open. Retained instances consume file descriptors and can prevent file deletion or replacement on Windows. The new test checks only the loaded values, so it misses this.
